scripts.build: bun build --target=bun src/server/index.ts --outdir dist --external playwright-core && bun scripts/pack-layerhand-mcp.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:mcp && bun run test:demo
scripts.check:mcp: cd packages/layerhand-mcp && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.graph: graphify update . && prettier --write --log-level=warn graphify-out && EC_VERSION=v4.0.2 editorconfig-checker -fix graphify-out/graph.json
scripts.lint: EC_VERSION=v4.0.2 editorconfig-checker && EC_VERSION=v4.0.2 editorconfig-checker -config .editorconfig-checker.exceptions.json -disable-indent-size src/web/mcp/prompt.ts && prettier --check .
